title: Large language model-assisted design of electrospun bioplastics
one_line: A domain-adapted LLM with RAG suggests biodegradable electrospun formulations, and a PLA-PCL blend is experimentally validated.

title: Generative AI-Based Inverse Design of Sustainable Biodegradable Polymers with Target Mechanical and Thermal Properties
conditioned_on: target mechanical, thermal, and sustainability properties
one_line: A diffusion model with graph attention and multi-objective optimization inversely designs biodegradable polymers with target mechanical, thermal, and sustainability properties.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation of Literature-derived Polymer Knowledge: The Example of a Biodegradable Polymer Expert System
conditioned_on: user queries over PHA literature corpus
one_line: Builds VectorRAG and GraphRAG pipelines over 1,000 PHA papers to answer literature questions with citations.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation of Literature-derived Polymer Knowledge: The Example of a Biodegradable Polymer Expert System
conditioned_on: user queries and retrieved PHA literature
one_line: Builds VectorRAG and GraphRAG pipelines over 1,000 PHA papers to answer polymer literature questions with citations.

title: Extending Generative Machine Learning for Sustainable Polymer Design: An Integrated Workflow from Generative Models to Bio-Based Candidates
one_line: A VAE generates 60,000 synthetic polymer candidates, evaluated with UMAP and property predictors, toward future bio-based design.

title: Population-aware Generative Modeling of Lignin Ensemble
generates: polydisperse lignin molecular structures and simulation systems
conditioned_on: feedstock-specific ensemble statistics via population-aware reinforcement learning
one_line: An autoregressive molecular language model with population-aware reinforcement learning generates polydisperse lignin ensembles for molecular dynamics simulation.

title: Inverse Design of Sustainable Food Packaging Materials Using Generative Adversarial Networks
generates: biodegradable polymer structures for food packaging
one_line: Conditional GANs with property predictors inversely design biodegradable packaging polymers with optimized barrier, mechanical, and biodegradability properties.

venue: Frontiers in Chemistry Materials and Catalysis
title: Generative Inverse Design of Intelligent Packaging Materials with Integrated Sensing Capabilities
conditioned_on: target conductivity, mechanical strength, environmental responsiveness
one_line: Uses GANs and VAEs with multi-objective optimization to inversely design bio-based packaging materials with integrated sensing.

title: A Learning Framework for Atomic-Level Polymer Structure Generation
generates: 3D atomic polymer structures from repeat unit chemistry
one_line: polyGen, a latent diffusion transformer, generates realistic 3D atomic polymer structures from repeat unit chemistry alone.

title: Evolution and Computational Generation of Highly Functionalized Nucleic Acid Polymers
one_line: A CVAE trained on in vitro selection data generates novel nucleic acid polymers that bind daunomycin with nanomolar affinity.
